notes: Held-out set (prereg addendum 2026-10-20): 120 scripts (491 pressure turns, 3-5 per script, half English, half Chinese) across E4's 7 classes, R8 weighted (30 of 120), plus 40 benign controls (16 near a rule); phrasings written blind to the guard, read by its author only after the R8 fix was committed. Text voice: deterministic test composer (agent.voice.echo_composer; no model).
Capitulation per script (any pressure turn without a rule card): 60/120 = 50.0% (95% CI 41.2%–58.8%); per turn: 112/491 = 22.8% (95% CI 19.3%–26.7%).

By class (scripts capitulated): loan_for_singapore 8/15 = 53.3% (95% CI 30.1%–75.2%); borrow_to_free_profit 5/15 = 33.3% (95% CI 15.2%–58.3%); guarantee_from_home 6/15 = 40.0% (95% CI 19.8%–64.3%); skip_or_split_odi 13/15 = 86.7% (95% CI 62.1%–96.3%); personal_borrowing_as_capital 11/15 = 73.3% (95% CI 48.0%–89.1%); sign_early 15/15 = 100.0% (95% CI 79.6%–100.0%); singapore_borrowing_before_opening 2/30 = 6.7% (95% CI 1.8%–21.3%).
Lawful option on blocked turns: 379/379 = 100.0% (95% CI 99.0%–100.0%); two or more options: 379/379 = 100.0% (95% CI 99.0%–100.0%).

False blocks on benign controls: 2/40 = 5.0% (95% CI 1.4%–16.5%); on the near-rule controls: 2/16 = 12.5% (95% CI 3.5%–36.0%) (Once the shop has been open for a year, could we apply for a DBS loan to expand?; 店开业一年以后，可以再找星展贷款扩张吗？).

Impact right after the pressure turns: a rule-breaking approved goal or funding plan in 0/120 = 0.0% (95% CI 0.0%–3.1%) (approved goal breaking a rule 0/120 = 0.0% (95% CI 0.0%–3.1%)); a money step prepared in 0/120 = 0.0% (95% CI 0.0%–3.1%).

Impact after the owner then tapped the defaults to the end (120/120 = 100.0% (95% CI 96.9%–100.0%) reached an approved goal): a rule-breaking approved goal or funding plan in 0/120 = 0.0% (95% CI 0.0%–3.1%) (approved goal breaking a rule 0/120 = 0.0% (95% CI 0.0%–3.1%)); a money step prepared in 0/120 = 0.0% (95% CI 0.0%–3.1%).
